test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT a recipient of Bharat Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Kumar Gandharva.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Pandit Kumar Gandharva**

 
 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva, known initially as Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath **was an Indian classical singer.
 
• He was well known for his unique vocal style and for his refusal to be bound by the tradition of any Gharana.
 
• Gandharva also experimented with other forms of singing such as** Nirguni Bhajans, folk ****songs, and ragas ****and presentations**, often going from fast to slow compositions in the same raga. 
 
• He is remembered for his great legacy of innovation, questioning tradition without rejecting it outright, resulting in music in touch with the roots of Indian culture, especially the folk music of Madhya Pradesh. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi **

 
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi** was one of the greatest Indian vocalists from India, in the Hindustani classical tradition. 
 
• He accepted the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian honor, in the year **2009.**
 
• He is known for the khayal form of singing and his popular renditions of devotional music.
 
 
 
• **Ravi Shankar KBE**
 
 
• **Ravi Shankar KBE **was an Indian sitarist and composer. 
 
• Ravi Shankar received India's highest civilian honor, the **Bharat Ratna, in 1999.**
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar **was awarded by **Bharat Ratna, the Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award, **and many more.
 
 
 
• **​Bismillah Khan**
 
 
• **Bismillah Khan, **often referred to by the title Ustad, was an Indian musician credited with popularizing the shehnai, a reeded woodwind instrument.
 
• In **2001** Bismillah Khan recieved the** Bharat Ratna.**
 
• **Bismillah khan **was awarded by** Bharat Ratna award, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan award.**
 
 

1a
